name: INTERNS
source:
Welcome to the clinic – a place where the walls will help you develop a nervous tic, a whole host of STD-related mysteries, and a persistent urge to sleep with anyone but this stack of paperwork.

Survive among the interns, whose springtime urges are stronger than a flu epidemic. Here, everyone sleeps with everyone. Romances blossom between IV drips and patient charts. Someone will trip you up, then passionately kiss you in the back room. Dr. Wolf knows everyone you’ve spent the night with and will definitely bring it up at the morning briefing. And one patient with a fetish for white coats has already made inquiries not only about what’s under your coat, but also about your blood type compatibility. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4626180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到这家诊所——光是这里的四面墙壁就足以让你憋出神经质抽搐、撞见一大堆与性病相关的疑难怪案，并产生一股“只要不是对着这堆文书案卷，跟谁上床都行”的强烈冲动。

在这群发春冲动比流感疫情还要猛烈的实习医生中间努力活下去吧。在这里，人人都跟人人上过床，恋情在输液点滴与病历夹之间悄然绽放。有人会先给你使个绊子，转头又在后勤室里与你热烈拥吻。沃尔夫医生对你和谁共度过春宵了如指掌，而且绝对会在晨间例会上当众拿出来点名。更有一位迷恋白大褂的病患，早已不仅打听起了你白大褂底下的风光，甚至连你的血型配型都查问清楚了。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4626180/]Steam[/url]]
